tool_args.rationale: The pilot reaches s_grad 2.44, near the stated critical range, but provides no observations above it. A high-gradient probe can identify whether an avalanche causes a downturn.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the avalanche siphon model to pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot gradients are below the proposed critical range, so they cannot identify the avalanche threshold or strength.
The correlated pilot inputs do not distinguish these smooth curves from a thresholded mechanism.
The high-gradient probe directly tests the unresolved threshold at lower cost.
